title: Nutty Gooey Korean Bean Bun
description: A hangover-cure Korean dish featuring chilli bean paste, crispy fry, and a nutty twist. Keto-friendly and perfect for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together mung bean paste, gochujang, sugar, salt, and 20ml of water.
Heat 10g of coconut oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the fried shallots and cook until crispy.
Add the crushed sesame seeds and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the mung bean paste mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the egg and stir until the mixture thickens.
Place the mung bean buns on a baking sheet and toast until lightly browned.
Spread the nutty gooey mixture on the toasted buns.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve immediately.
